Here’s exactly how to move it in Google Calendar on your laptop:

1. Go to calendar.google.com and make sure you’re on Week or Day view for Dec 12–13, 2025.
2. Find “Teacher Meeting” on Friday 2025-12-12 at 3:00–3:30pm.
3. Click and hold the event, then drag it from Friday 3:00pm to Saturday 3:00pm and release.  
   - That will automatically keep it as a 30‑minute event (3:00–3:30pm).
4. If a popup appears asking to send updates, you can just confirm (it only affects your own calendar since you’re the only attendee).

Alternative (if you’d rather edit instead of drag):
1. Click the “Teacher Meeting” event on Friday, then click the pencil (Edit) icon.
2. Change the date field from 2025-12-12 to 2025-12-13.
3. Make sure the time is still 3:00–3:30pm.
4. Click Save.

Once you’ve done that, you’ll be all set with the meeting on Saturday instead.</action>
